messages.content: It's extremely hot today and my air conditioner is currently turned off. Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
We need to parse user request: "Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour". They want to turn on AC with cooling mode, target temp 20°C, wind strength mid, and schedule power off after an hour. Also they mention "mid wind strength" but we have windStrength options: LOW, HIGH, MID. So use MID.

Also they want to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. That means set airConJobMode to COOL, targetTemperature 20, windStrength MID. And schedule power off after an hour: relativeHourToStop=1? Wait relativeHourToStop is number of hours from current time when the appliance should stop. So set relativeHourToStop=1. But also we might need to set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON to start. Also maybe we need to set airConJobMode to COOL. Also we may need to set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON. Also we might need to set relativeHourToStop=1. Also we might need to set relativeMinuteToStop=0? Not necessary; relativeMinuteToStop defaults to null. But we can set relativeMinuteToStop=0? Actually relativeMinuteToStop is number of minutes from current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, no schedule. We want to stop after an hour. So relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. But relativeMinuteToStop is optional; we can leave as null. But we might want to set relativeMinuteToStop=0 to be explicit. But the function expects numbers or null. We'll set relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0.

Also we might need to set relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart? They want to start now. So relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0? Or we can just set airConOperationMode=POWER_ON. The function has airConOperationMode param. Setting to POWER_ON will start immediately. So we don't need relativeHourToStart/relativeMinuteToStart. But we can set them to 0. But it's optional. Let's just set airConOperationMode=POWER_ON.

Also we might need to set airConJobMode to COOL. The default is COOL anyway. But we can set explicitly.

Also we might need to set monitoringEnabled? No.

Also we might need to set powerSaveEnabled? No.

Also we might need to set airCleanOperationMode? No.

So final body:

{
airConJobMode: "COOL",
windStrength: "MID",
targetTemperature: 20,
airConOperationMode: "POWER_ON",
relativeHourToStop: 1,
relativeMinuteToStop: 0
}

But we also need to ensure we pass all keys? The function signature says body: { ... } with many optional fields. We can provide only those we want. So we can send only the ones we need.

Thus we call ThinQ_Connect with body containing above fields.
